title: AMD Stock Falls 10.9% After Intel Q4 Outlook (Oct 30)
summary: AMD stock closed at $504.80 on Oct 30, 2026, down 10.88%, as chip stocks fell after Intel forecast lower Q4 revenue and a longer PC slowdown.
body_markdown:
## Why AMD Stock Fell


According to[Intel's third-quarter release](https://www.intc.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1786/intel-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results) , published after the close on October 29, the company forecast fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion and non-GAAP earnings of $0.25 per share, after third-quarter revenue of $16.5 billion. Revenue from its Client Computing and Physical AI Group fell 5% year over year to $8.1 billion.


In the same release, Intel chief financial officer David Zinsner said, "Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year."


As reported by[TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/amd-stock-dives-along-other-semiconductor-shares-and-investors-can-blame-intel-intc) , financial media tied AMD's Friday drop to[Intel's warning of weak PC demand](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/intel-plunges-21-on-weak-pc-guidance-chip-stocks-sell-off/) , which hit semiconductor stocks broadly. TipRanks noted that the PC market is important to both chipmakers.


## AMD Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- AMD's Data Center segment revenue rose 107% year over year to $6.7 billion in the second quarter of 2026, according to the[company's second-quarter release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000002488/000000248826000121/q22026991.htm) .
- In the same release, AMD guided third-quarter revenue of approximately $13 billion, plus or minus $300 million, with a non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 56%, compared with second-quarter revenue of $11.5 billion.


### Risks


- Intel expects the PC slowdown to continue at least through the first half of next year, and TipRanks described the PC market as important to both AMD and Intel.
- AMD's Client business brought in $3.1 billion of second-quarter revenue, up 23% year over year, so a longer PC slowdown touches a segment that has been growing.
- Intel's fourth-quarter revenue forecast of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion sits below its third-quarter revenue of $16.5 billion, and the session's selling spread across chipmakers from Intel to Marvell.


The next confirmed event is AMD's fiscal third-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, after the market close, with a conference call at 5 p.m. ET, according to[AMD's announcement](https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1300/amd-to-report-fiscal-third-quarter-2026-financial-results) .
